description: Therapeutic medicine categories suitable for organizing a pharmacy management system in Egypt. Categories are application-oriented and not an official exhaustive classification issued by the Egyptian Drug Authority.
source_note: The Egyptian Drug Authority publishes the Egyptian Drug Formulary by therapeutic chapters and maintains national medicine lists. This application dataset organizes common pharmacy categories into practical groups for software use.

categories.name: Alimentary Tract & Metabolism
categories.description: Medicines affecting the digestive system and metabolism.

categories.name: Antacids & Acid Suppressants

categories.name: Antiulcer Medicines
categories.description: Medicines used in the treatment and prevention of peptic ulcers.
